Q1: 1-Butoxy-2-propanol displays a varied hazard tier profile. It is categorized as having an "Expanded Perspective" (Tier 2) for Carcinogenicity, Mutagenicity, and Reproductive (CMR), Inhalation (IHL), and Dermal and Eye (SKN) hazards, suggesting potential concerns beyond official GHS classifications. While considered of "Demonstrated Low/Moderate Hazard" (Tier 3) for Environmental (ENV) and Oral (ORL) hazards, there are notable data deficiencies (Tier 4) for Endocrine Disruption (EDC) and Organ and Systemic (OGN) hazards, meaning their risks are currently unknown.
Q2: This chemical is not present on any identified lists of concern. However, it is featured on the SCIL Green Circle list, indicating that it has been verified to be of low concern based on available experimental and modeled data.
